title: Copilot Studio: makers can require human approval before an agent runs a tool
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing governance controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned approval toggle from the documented end-user confirmation setting, and keeps unpublished defaults, approval details and central enforcement open. The cited Learn pages opened successfully despite the pre-check's rate-limit responses.
